BV1PLa66TEYn.ingredients: Eggs, warm water, salt and soaked shredded dried scallops. A little dark finishing sauce is visible but unnamed.
BV1PLa66TEYn.quantities: Egg-to-water volume ratio 1:2; steam over medium heat for 7 minutes, then rest covered 2–3 minutes.
steps: Mix eggs with twice their volume of warm water and a little salt.
Pour into a plate, add some scallop shreds and cover the plate before covering the steamer.
Steam over medium heat 7 minutes and rest 2–3 minutes. Serve with the small amount of dark sauce shown.
BV1PLa66TEYn.missing: Egg count, scallop amount and soaking time, exact water temperature and sauce identity are unspecified.

BV1PLa66TEYn.ingredients: Luffa, finely minced garlic, starch, peanut oil, salt and dried scallop shreds.
BV1PLa66TEYn.quantities: Steam for 5 minutes. Other amounts are unspecified.
steps: Peel and cut the luffa and mince garlic finely.
Immediately before steaming, mix with garlic, starch, peanut oil and salt to avoid drawing out water too early.
Plate, scatter scallop shreds and steam 5 minutes.
BV1PLa66TEYn.missing: Vegetable weight, heat and seasoning ratios are absent.

BV1PLa66TEYn.ingredients: Squid, green beans, thin carrot slices, okra and water; scallions, oil, soy sauce and sugar for the dressing. Wasabi is optional.
BV1PLa66TEYn.quantities: Separate boiling times and dressing ratios are unspecified.
steps: Cook beans and thin carrot slices, then cook okra and plate the vegetables.
Separately cook the cut squid and arrange over the vegetables.
Fry scallions in oil until fragrant, remove the scallions and turn off the heat. Mix soy sauce and sugar into the oil.
Pour over squid and vegetables. The creator also suggests wasabi.
BV1PLa66TEYn.missing: Oil temperature, bean and squid cooking durations, salinity and sugar quantity are unknown.

BV1PLa66TEYn.ingredients: Salmon pieces, black pepper salt and lemon zest. Additional frying oil is unconfirmed.
BV1PLa66TEYn.quantities: Fish weight, thickness and cooking time are unspecified.
steps: Pan fry the salmon on both sides until cooked.
Add black pepper salt and a little grated lemon zest near the end, toss and serve.
BV1PLa66TEYn.missing: Lemon juice is not explicitly added here and is not invented from common pairings.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: Prepared whole chicken, water and salt; shallots, sand ginger, garlic or grated ginger, peanut oil and soy sauce for the dip.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: Maintain the lowest heat with a gentle simmer and poach about 30 minutes. Chicken weight and water volume are absent.
steps: Put the whole chicken in hot water and add a little salt. Pork belly shares the pot in this video.
Keep the water gently simmering on the lowest heat for about 30 minutes, then remove the chicken.
Cool and chop. An ice-water bath is suggested, but the full bath is not shown.
Chop shallot, sand ginger and garlic and mix with peanut oil and soy sauce. Grated ginger is offered as an alternative.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: Chicken weight, initial temperature and internal doneness are unknown, so 30 minutes cannot be generalized to every chicken. Dip ratios are absent.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: Rice and the broth left from cooking the chicken.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: Rice-broth ratio and cooker cycle duration are unspecified.
steps: Put rice in the rice cooker and ladle in the hot chicken broth.
Use a sufficiently long cooking cycle; the creator cautions against a very short quick-cook cycle with this hot broth.
Fluff the cooked rice and serve alongside the meal.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: Exact program, rice quantity, broth salinity and liquid level are absent.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: White radish, previously prepared beef offal and its sauce, with coriander visible at the end.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: The radish has been scalded beforehand. Subsequent simmering time is unknown.
steps: Cut and briefly scald the radish.
Put it in a clay pot with the prepared offal and sauce, cover and simmer until the radish is cooked.
Finish with a little coriander as shown.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: The offal's original braising recipe, additional water, radish quantity and total time are unspecified.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: Pork belly, water and salt, served with this video's shallot-ginger-garlic oil and soy dip.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: Pork weight, thickness and its separate cooking time are not given.
steps: Place pork belly in the pot first and cook alongside the chicken until done.
Remove and cool. Slice part thinly as plain boiled pork and serve with the peanut-oil and soy dipping mixture.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: The 30-minute statement concerns the chicken and is not established as a universal pork-belly timing.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: Previously boiled pork belly and prepared barbecue seasoning.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: Air-fryer temperature and duration are not supplied.
steps: Cut off a piece of the already cooked pork belly and air fry it.
Brown the surface and render some fat, then remove and cut into pieces.
Sprinkle with a little prepared barbecue seasoning.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: Full roasting parameters and crackling preparation are absent. This is not a complete crispy-pork recipe starting from raw meat.

BV1uYao6fEYc.ingredients: Green beans and liquid in the pot; the dip uses this video's shallots, sand ginger, garlic, peanut oil and soy sauce.
BV1uYao6fEYc.quantities: Bean quantity and cooking time are unspecified.
steps: Cut beans, cook them in the remaining pot liquid and drain.
Serve with the shallot-ginger-garlic oil and soy mixture as a dip; the creator does not pour all the dressing over the beans.
BV1uYao6fEYc.missing: Exact liquid composition, salinity and bean cooking duration are unknown.
